name: Brute Force
keywords: brute force password guessing repeated failed logins ssh rdp ftp credential
description: Adversaries try many passwords or credentials against an account or service until one works. Typical signs are many failed logins from one source in a short time.
mitigation: Block the source IP, enforce account lockout and multi-factor authentication, and review recent logins for the targeted account.

name: Valid Accounts
keywords: valid accounts compromised credentials successful login after failed attempts
description: Adversaries use stolen or guessed credentials to log in as a legitimate user, which can follow a successful brute-force attack.
mitigation: Reset the affected passwords, review account activity, and check for logins from unusual locations.

name: Network Denial of Service
keywords: denial of service dos ddos flood syn flood high packet rate bandwidth exhaustion
description: Adversaries flood a target with network traffic to exhaust bandwidth or connection capacity, making the service unavailable.
mitigation: Apply rate limiting, enable upstream DDoS protection or filtering, and block the offending sources.

name: Endpoint Denial of Service
keywords: endpoint denial of service application layer flood high request rate server overload
description: Adversaries overload a specific host or application with requests so that it can no longer serve legitimate users.
mitigation: Throttle requests per client, scale or protect the affected service, and use a web application firewall.

name: Network Service Discovery
keywords: port scan service discovery many ports syn scan reconnaissance enumeration
description: Adversaries scan hosts to find open ports and running services that they can attack later. Typical signs are connections to many ports in a short time.
mitigation: Block the scanning source, close unneeded ports, and monitor for follow-up attempts against the exposed services.

name: Active Scanning
keywords: active scanning reconnaissance probing scan vulnerability scan
description: Adversaries probe external systems to gather information before an attack, for example by scanning IP ranges or services.
mitigation: Rate-limit and block repeated probing, and review the exposed attack surface.

name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
keywords: web attack sql injection exploit http errors web application vulnerability xss
description: Adversaries exploit weaknesses in internet-facing applications, such as injection flaws, to gain access. Typical signs are a high ratio of HTTP errors and unusual requests.
mitigation: Patch the application, enable a web application firewall, validate inputs, and review the web server logs.

name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
keywords: command execution script shell after web exploit remote code
description: Adversaries run commands or scripts on a compromised system, which can follow a successful web application exploit.
mitigation: Isolate the host if compromise is suspected and review process and command history.

name: Normal activity
keywords: benign normal traffic false positive routine low failed logins
description: Traffic and login patterns within normal ranges, with no sign of known attack behavior. Alerts like this are usually false positives.
mitigation: No action needed. Consider tuning the detection rule that raised the alert.
